articles.title: Red card system in disarray over Trump, Fifa and Balogun decision
articles.summary: The decision to effectively overturn the red card shown to United States forward Folarin Balogun leaves many unanswered questions.

articles.title: Trump thanks Fifa after USA striker Balogun's ban suspended
articles.summary: Folarin Balogun is available to play for the United States in their World Cup last-16 tie against Belgium after his one-game ban is suspended by Fifa.

articles.title: Haaland double fires Norway into World Cup quarter-finals
articles.summary: Erling Haaland scores twice as Norway knock out five-time champions Brazil, and progress to the quarter-finals of the 2026 World Cup.

articles.title: Queiroz leaves Ghana following World Cup exit
articles.summary: Carlos Queiroz steps down as Ghana head coach after three months in charge following their World Cup exit.

articles.title: Who am I? Guess World Cup star No 28
articles.summary: Will you get today's player in as few attempts as possible?

articles.title: Thousands welcome home Cape Verde players after stunning World Cup run
articles.summary: Tens of thousands of fans formed an ocean of blue outside the airport in capital city, Praia.

articles.title: Balogun ban overturned amid reports White House contacted FIFA
articles.summary: FIFA has stepped in to make banned USA striker Folarin Balogun available for the World Cup last-16 tie with Belgium.

articles.title: Australia romp past England to secure seventh Women's T20 World Cup title
articles.summary: Australia dashed England's hopes of a first Women's T20 World Cup win in 17 years and second overall as they romped to a seven-wicket victory at Lord's to secure a record-extending seventh title.
